text:
Noah Rivera: Hi team — first-week setup question. My kit arrived but two things: the monitor stand screws are missing and the USB-C dock charges the laptop but the external monitor stays black when connected via DP. Also can't join corp-secure wifi (802.1X)  it immediately prompts 'authentication failed'. Anyone who can help?

Jules - IT: Welcome Noah! :wave: Quick checks: 1) Try connecting the monitor directly to the laptop to confirm panel works. 2) On Windows, check Device Manager for any DisplayLink or vendor hub drivers. If it's a Mac, run `networksetup -listallhardwareports`. Which OS/image are you on?

Noah Rivera: I'm on company Windows 11 image. Direct-attach works fine, so monitor is OK. When plugged into dock, Windows detects a display in Settings but screen stays black. DP cable is the one included in the box.

Jules - IT: That usually indicates the dock's DP handshake isn't negotiating power on. Can you open Device Manager > Universal Serial Bus controllers and note any entries named like "USB3 Hub" or vendor names (e.g., DisplayLink, ASMedia)? Also try swapping the USB-C port on your laptop.

Noah Rivera: In USB controllers I see "Generic USB Hub" and "ASIX AX88179 USB 3.0 to Gigabit Ethernet". No DisplayLink listed. Tried both USB-C ports, same result.

Jules - IT: Thanks. I've created IT-341210 and attached your notes. I'll push the vendor dock driver remotely at 16:00 PT; if that doesn't work we'll swap the dock. I also requested missing VESA screws to be shipped.

ship-bot: [IT-341210] Parts order: VESA screw kit (M4x10) + spare DisplayPort cable. ETA next business day. Tracking TBA.

Maya (Facilities): Hey Noah  I can drop off a small hardware kit (screws + allen key) at your desk now. Ping me if you want that.

Noah Rivera: Please do, that would be huge. Also the Wi-Fi: when I try corp-secure it asks for login, I enter SSO and MFA, then Wi-Fi fails with "EAP authentication failed".

Jules - IT: EAP errors often mean a stale cert/profile. On Windows, open Control Panel -> Credential Manager and remove any saved network creds for corp domain, then try again. If still fails, I'll temporarily enable a one-hour wired token so you can attend onboarding.

Noah Rivera: Guest token would help; my onboarding call starts in 30.

Jules - IT: Done  one-hour wired token DM'ed to you. Also noted IT-341210 to prioritize before end of day. If the driver push at 16:00 causes any downtime I'll rollback.

ship-bot: DM sent: hardware drop scheduled.

Maya (Facilities): Dropped screws at desk A-12. Let me know if they're the right size.

Noah Rivera: Got them, perfect fit. Onboarding call went fine with the wired token. Thanks everyone  will report back after the driver push.

Jules - IT: Closing loop for now. Ticket IT-341210 will track dock driver push and possible swap. Tag me if the external display remains dark after 16:00. :thumbsup:
